name: ai.pubfi/mcp
title: PubFi MCP
description: Use MCP 2026-07-28 discovery or 2025-11-25 initialize to list and execute PubFi routes.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: PubFi API key as a Bearer token. Optional for public capability list/get calls; required for route execution unless the client uses the accountless x402 lane. Example: Bearer <PubFi API key>.
